steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Someone! Anyone!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: You again! Didn't we just let you out?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Keep making noise, and it's no more Mr. Nice Guy!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Daizi!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: This box is holding something that can save the city, so shut up and give it to Zuo.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: This is... data for the Imperial Astronomical Bureau? And a token?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Girl? How did this come into your possession? Hey, wake up!

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Hurry! Call the medic!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where... where exactly did this woman come from?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Has Superintendent Ch'en finally met her match?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chi Xiao can't cut through her Arts.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you can even call it Arts in the first place...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: She doesn't seem to know any kung fu, but her swordplay is ridiculously quick.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It's like the kind of kung fu you find in those fake 'forbidden techniques' manuals that say they'll teach you transcend space and time.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'll trade a few more blows with her and see if I can figure it out...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Careful now, she's not playing with us.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Slip up once and you might die.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Even if you don't, you still will.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You want a few more rounds with me? Sure, let's start with you.
This time, her blade flies quicker than in their previous bouts. Waai Fu can only feel the autumn wind brushing against her face, leaving her no time to react.
Suddenly, a wall appears in front of her, or rather, a man's back as thick and wide as a wall.
Waai Fu looks at the wall in front of her that she last saw over a decade ago. Still, the sight overlaps with the one in her memories.
The reunion comes sooner than she expected, and catches her off guard.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: So this is the one Lee mentioned, the one who's been bothering everyone?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You again?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Turns out I've been sleeping bad because I was about to run into someone I'd rather not see.
Huai Tianpei sweeps a quick glance behind him.
His movements are light and quick, but Waai Fu catches them perfectly clearly.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I didn't want to fight anybody until my match with the Grandmaster.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: *sigh*... Guess today's a cheat day.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: So yeah, you've got some skills, but I can't say I know any kung fu school where you bully your juniors for practice.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: If you're itching for a fight, I'll take you on!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Huai, you're at a disadvantage unarmed. I'll lend you my sword.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Don't need it.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Anything my fists can't break, a sword won't cut either.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Don't overestimate yourself.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Haah—!
Waai Fu gets a front row seat to the action.
Sidestep, chop, quick step, twist, elbow strike. All moves she has learned herself.
Seeing the pained expression on his opponent's face, it is clear that Huai Tianpei is using his full strength.
Waai Fu imagines what it feels like to be slammed into a wall.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: That's some blade. I dodged it by a hair, but it caught my skin.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Damn you—

After being knocked back several feet, the woman steadies herself with her blade. The tremendous impact seems to have little lasting effect on her, as she lifts her sword again and assumes a defensive stance.
But being knocked off-balance has made her furious, and anger whips into a tangible wind, with everyone present feeling a chill run up their spines at the same time.
The moonlight intensifies.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Still got more tricks under her sleeve?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: This sensation again...

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Oh? Her Qi feels different... Great, let's go for another round!

steps.name: Di Beast
steps.text: (low-pitched hissing)
The woman raises her head and glances toward the sky, the clouds drifting across and obscuring half the moonlight.
She lowers her half-raised blade.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Since the girl already delivered the data, I'm not going bother with you any longer.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: It doesn't matter. You're out of time.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Yumen city won't escape this calamity.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Seems like we weren't needed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We did witness a splendid showdown, though, so I wouldn't say it was a waste.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The young will surpass us in time.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I assumed you were referring to that fellow.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'd say Ch'en here has already learned a good chunk of what you have to offer.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What do you think of her swordplay?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Skillful, but not yet the peak of perfection.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So what you mean to say is...
Brother Meng—!
A sorrowful howl resounds through the long and deserted street.
Back at the agency, Waai Fu saw plenty of soap operas depicting children reunited with their parents.
Some cried bitterly while others threw furniture around, the actors' intense performances felt strange and unfamiliar to Waai Fu.
When watching with Hung or Lee, they would always silently change the channel.

She tried to imagine what it would be like when she saw him again. The pent-up resentment, anger, confusion, and dissatisfaction that accumulated over a decade... How would she express herself to him?
But at this very moment, the man standing right in front of her feels less real than the cold wind blowing on her face.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You came to my rescue, so thanks for that.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Sure...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Anything else you'd like to say?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I'm good.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Then prepare yourself.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Alright.
Dad, what does 'Hung Mei Wing Chun' mean?
Of all the countless kung fu styles under Heaven, you choose this one, huh? Alright, I'll teach you this one.
Which style do you use, dad? I want to learn the same one as you.
I'll teach you mine, but not now. You still haven't mastered the basics. Once you've got a solid foundation, then you can learn my kung fu.
Okay!
I've sparred with him so many times that I've lost count.
The moment our fists connect, my arm adapts with my muscle memory. More submerged memories also flow out from my mind.
A small courtyard with blue brick and stone flooring, a large porcelain water jar always filled full, wooden stakes wrapped with cloth... and a tall figure whose face could never be clearly seen.
That was my world, day after day, diligently practicing and enduring hardships, year after year, cultivating my mind and tempering my character.
My sparring partner changed from my father to a wooden dummy, never letting myself rest, even for a day. Over the past decade, practicing kung fu became as natural as eating and sleeping.
I think I asked him the question.
'Why?'
Why did you teach me kung fu, why did you have me become a warrior just like you?
The intertwining of moves and techniques, the simple and genuine connection.
You've taught me so much.
But I was never chasing you.
I've found my own goals, I know why I practice kung fu, and I won't change the path I chose just because a man's back popped up in front of me.
And I will surpass you.
A fist lands on the man's robust chest, as if hitting a thick wall.
It gives off a muffled sound.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: You've improved over the years, but you're still a long way from matching me.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Big talk. But I wouldn't have even landed a hit on you back then.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If this is as far as you've come in a dozen years, then I'll catch up to you real soon.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: My daughter enjoys some big talk.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: That's not a compliment.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I lose.
Huai Tianpei twirls his beard, thinks for a long time, and suddenly bursts into laughter.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: That move where you kicked me in the chin doesn't look like anything I taught you.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: ...What fun.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Anyway, I'm heading back to the clinic.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Huai, wait a second.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Do you need me for something?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Where is the Grandmaster's sword? And Zuo Le?

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: The sword's with the girl, and that mandarin boy probably went after her.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Can't say for sure. I'm pretty much done with all this stuff.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The Grandmaster wants to see you.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: I've been going easy on you, since you're Anasa.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: But hand over the sword now, or I'll show no mercy.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: No.
Her wound reopens, and the young Anasa girl holds the sword in front of her chest with her left hand, throwing her chakram with her right, barely deflecting the enemy's attack.
She falls back step by step, as her arms feel heavier and heavier.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It just occurred to me that even if I let you go, you still need a way out.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: How did you know I would be here?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I grew up here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I was a mischievous boy who tried to sneak out of the city through the sand sluices, and was duly punished by my father for doing so.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But only someone as stubborn as you would dare take this way.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You still want to stop me.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Tell me, did you come to Yumen just for this sword?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And you wish to present the sword as an offering?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And after that, will you return it?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Well, I...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Yes, I will.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: That eccentric from the clinic promised me earlier that if you broke your word, he would bring you back himself.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But having said all that, retrieving the sword was, and still is, my duty.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So while I have no qualms about taking you at your word, just this once, I will get that sword back, even if I have to jump into the sand sluice myself.

spans.text: So while I have no qualms about taking you at your word, just this once, I
get that sword back, even if I have to jump into the sand sluice myself.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: 'Yi nuo qian jin.' You may not know the idiom, literally 'a promise worth a thousand gold.' Break your word, and I will drag you back here, personally.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: You're wasting your effort. Hurt as she is, she'll die when she jumps down there.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Three quarters past the Hour of Yu... the turbines should have slowed down by now, there's no time to waste.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Get going!
The young Candleholder turns around to face his powerful foe, and a light gleams from his sword unsheathing.
The young Anasa girl hugs the sword tightly in her arms, and leaps down into the churning sand.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: The observatory has recalculated its results according to the information we have just received.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: The Catastrophe has manifested as a sandstorm, and its scale is about three times larger than the one that struck the city four years ago.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: The prior misinformation has already cost us too much time, so the situation is not optimistic...
Zuo Xuanliao looks at the box in his hands, the surface clearly worn down by gravel and sand.
A few days ago, was there another person looking at this box just as he is now? How did he feel?
If there was a mirror in his military tent, Zuo Xuanliao would have noticed the strands of silver hair on his scalp multiplying over the past few days.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Let's get to the point.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: Presently, Yumen is in the middle of the Catastrophe's trajectory, and won't be able to avoid it, even if we change course.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: We have but one method available to us. We can split Yumen up into blocks and disperse in different directions to evade the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: How much time would that cost us?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: Reconnecting after separation, and returning to full speed, will probably take about six months.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: There's no time.

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: It is the only feasible way to ensure the city's safety.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: It is not the city's safety we want to secure.
The General lingers in his tent, the night outside his window still seemingly serene. The unseen danger lurks far away, but he knows it is still out there.
He has seen these sights for decades, but he has never loathed the vast desert as much as he does right now.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: If we can only ensure the safety of our people...

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: General, you mean to...?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Prepare the front for direct Catastrophe impact, and evacuate all civilians from the east side of the core city to the west for resettlement.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Activate all defensive fortifications, and station Imperial Astronomical Bureau Casters on the city walls to resist the aftershocks.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: How long will repairs take, after the fact?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: General Zuo, the risk is too great...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: How long will they take?

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: Repairing the front walls and some of the city's infrastructure will take... by a conservative estimate, three months.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Sure...

steps.name: Imperial Astronomical Bureau Representative
steps.text: Time is of the essence, so I urge the General to make a decision as soon as possible.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Have you come to shackle me, to ensure I don't act on my own?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I'm here to relay the Grand Tutor's opinion—to trust in General Zuo's judgement.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Prepare to confront the Catastrophe.
